description: Brad Ochocki Szasz's OFFICIAL MozillaOnline -> canonical Firefox desktop migration model, ingested for the July 2026 forecast cycle. Supersedes the retired data-grounded placeholder (mozillaonline_migration_model.placeholder.2026-06-25). Daily migration DAU that flips from app_name='Firefox Desktop MozillaOnline' to app_name='Firefox Desktop' (the canonical KPI); an additive desktop tailwind, >92% China.

coverage.hold_flat_basis: 2026-12-31 28d-MA level; frozen through the 2027-12-31 horizon to avoid a zero-cliff

os_scope.basis: measured pre-transition (May 2-15 baseline) app_name='Firefox Desktop MozillaOnline' by os_version x app_version_major
os_scope.rationale: winX (older Windows) users are 99% pinned on ancient Firefox that cannot receive the migrating build, so they do not migrate; the migration originates from and lands in modern_windows. modern_windows-only is the correct allocation, not merely the simplest.

geo_shares_source: Retained from the placeholder's mozonline_geo_windows.csv baseline distribution (CN baseline 976,788 reproduced to the dollar by the July OS-split re-query). The official export is geo-aggregate, so these fixed shares are carried forward.
applier_contract: Bidirectional overlay (code `o`): subtract migration_dau_daily * renormalized_country_share from modern_windows legacy_desktop training rows before mozaic, add the same back to modern_windows + ALL forecast rows. IR excluded (scope.exclude_countries); shares renormalized over training-present countries.
